jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) TUBEROSE LIQUID HAND AND BODY SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with dispenser.

Tuberose | The elegance of tuberose turns into a stroll through a garden of white flowers. A captivating blend of freshly cut flowers with a touch of green and citrus notes.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, chamomile, violet leaves.
Heart notes: floral, jasmine, muguet, tuberose.
Base notes: oriental, iris, vanilla.
